notes.title: My Trainer is a Futanari OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
My Trainer is a Futanari OUT NOW!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950460/My_Trainer_is_a_Futanari/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/1950460/My_Trainer_is_a_Futanari/[/url]

Monday is Leg day!


"New year, new me!"

You decided to make the commitment of signing up for a full membership at your local gym.
You went the extra mile and got a personal trainer to help you along and hold you accountable.
Kendra comes highly recommended and with her abs of steel, she's often touted as: "THE REAL DEAL".

Get ready for the workout of a lifetime!
